name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 28 times in 9 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 56 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-07-03, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
